title: Galatea Mag-Bind Blood & Tissue DNA HDQ 96 Kit
author: Opentrons (verified)
materials: Mag-Bind Blood & Tissue DNA HDQ 96 Kit
Elution solution is added to the samples.
Beads are resuspended in elution solution.

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Specify number of samples (1‑96, divisible by 8), deepwell plate type, reservoir type, starting sample volume (µL), binding‑buffer volume (µL), elution volume (µL), tip‑parking option, and P300 mount side (left or right).

steps.title: Mix binding buffer
steps.instruction: Mix the binding buffer by pipetting up and down five times.

steps.title: Add binding buffer to samples
steps.instruction: Dispense the specified binding‑buffer volume into each sample well of the deepwell plate positioned on the magnetic module.

steps.title: Engage magnet and incubate
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module and incubate for 7 minutes.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant from each well and dispense into the liquid‑waste container.

steps.title: First wash (add & mix)
steps.instruction: Add wash buffer to each well, resuspend beads by mixing, then remove supernatant to waste.

steps.title: Second wash (repeat)
steps.instruction: Add second wash buffer, resuspend by mixing, and remove supernatant to waste (repeat of step 6 with second buffer).

steps.title: Third wash (no mix)
steps.instruction: Add third wash buffer without resuspension, then remove supernatant to waste.

steps.title: Dry beads
steps.instruction: Incubate the beads on the magnetic module for 1 minute to dry.

steps.title: Add elution solution
steps.instruction: Add the specified elution volume to each well.

steps.title: Resuspend beads in elution
steps.instruction: Resuspend the beads by mixing in the elution solution.

steps.title: Incubate elution
steps.instruction: Incubate the elution solution for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Engage magnet for elution
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module and incubate for 7 minutes (variable settling time).

steps.title: Transfer eluate to plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the eluted DNA samples to the elution plate located in Slot 1.
